notes.title: Lunistice ver. 1.05 Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

Right before Christmas I have a little present for you: Lunistice ver. 1.05 is out now! 🎄🎁
This update focuses mostly on adding a better camera system and some rebalancing, especially for Toree's levels. 

I'd also like to take this opportunity to thank you so so much for your support! The release of Lunistice is now a little over a month ago and the amount of support and feedback I got (and am still getting) is nothing short of amazing! 💖

I always said that my main goal for Lunistice was to just have a bunch of people have a good and chill time for a little while in these truly stressful times. And I'm incredibly humbled that my little game seemed to do just that for... a lot more than a "bunch" of people.

I can't wait to show you all what I've got in store for the next project! If you'd like to keep up in real-time with updates on any future projects (and I'm planning to be as open and communicative about the dev process as with this game), be sure to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/YfXtjAR]Community Discord[/url] and/or follow me on [url=http://twitter.com/AGrumpyFox/]Twitter[/url]!

Thank you so, so much for all of your support. Y'all made this past grueling year 100% worth it 🙇

And now: have a changelog! Happy Holidays! 💖

[h2]Lunistice ver. 1.05 Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [b]"Smooth Camera"[/b] option to the Camera menu. This will smooth out horizontal camera movement overall, which should (hopefully) lead to a much more controllable character and reduced motion sickness for many people. This option is [b]active by default[/b] on [i]fresh save files only[/i] and can be deactivated at any time to restore the camera to its old behaviour
[*]Added UI elements for tracking your progress in Stage 5-2
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Overhauled camera snapping (left trigger button). Instead of using Hana's view direction for recentering it'll now take player input into account (when moving). This means that the camera should now snap to where you want to go, not where the character's currently looking at
[*]Removed a bunch of enemies from Toree's levels. Mind you, Toree is still considered the de facto "hard-mode" of the game and you [b]will[/b] have to do some "weird" jumps, but most if not all of the really unfair enemies should be gone now
[*]Rebalanced final section of Stage 2-1
[*]Very slight rebalancing of Stage 2-2
[*]Rebalanced Stage 4-2. Again 
[*]Very slight rebalancing of Stage 5-2
[*]Made hitboxes on rolling pin stage hazards much more lenient
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed being able to easily bypass a certain part of Stage 7-2
[*]Fixed weird collision on the final parts of Stage 6-1 where you could lose your double jump easily
[/list]

notes.title: Lunistice ver. 1.03 Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

Time for another quick update! [b]Ver. 1.03 is now LIVE![/b]

I'll make it short and sweet, so check out the changelog below <3

[h2]Lunistice ver. 1.03 Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Made timings for jumping at the end of grind rails in 6-2 a bit more lenient
[*]Rebalanced rail segment in 3-1 level secret
[*]Rebalanced final rail segment in 3-2 to be a bit more forgiving
[*]Rebalanced "blind drop" in 6-1
[*]Changed input buffer for launchers. It should be harder to accidentally double jump and miss the target when being launched now.
[*]Removed Hana's "A-Pose" from all animations. Just to be clear: it wasn't an "A-Pose", by the way, it was an actual falling animation and it was *certainly* not a T-Pose, what are you even talking abou--- [i]hey what are you doing don't take away my keyboa-[/i]
[*]You can now actually use the down button in the act selection for stage 7
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed camera recentering not working properly on grind rails
[*]Fixed invisible collider in spiral bridge section of stage T
[*]Fixed glitching into file select from results menu by spamming ESC
[*]Fixed softlock by resetting to checkpoint while bouncing off a platform and entering a water bubble
[*]Fixed grind rail overlay vanishing when switching to hi-res mode while on a rail
[*][i]Fixed Stage 5-2 music[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Lunistice ver. 1.02 Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

[b]The first update for Lunistice - ver. 1.02 - is now LIVE![/b]

Before we jump into the changelog, let me thank each and everyone of you for your absolutely fantastic support and feedback! I would never have dreamed that so many people would be interested in my little game. [b]Thank you so, so much![/b] 💖

And thanks to your amazing feedback, I can present ver. 1.02 of Lunistice! This update not only fixes a bunch of bugs, but also adds a few quality-of-life options, like being able to "unlock" vertical camera movement, being able to unlock the mouse from the game (which was necessary for certain accessibility software) and... [b]High-Res Mode![/b]

You can now enjoy Lunistice in... uh.. HD! [i]Kinda[/i]! Textures and models are still very much adhere to the standards from 25 years ago 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992870/4ac5ed518000634b8e3e46943f815feddceaaf36.jpg[/img]

Please note that the new options are currently not translated into French, Spanish, Italian and Japanese! I'm working on getting those localized and will update them in an upcoming hotfix.

Oh! And! [b]This update also aims to iron out some wonky, kinda flow-breaking level designs! Specifically in Stages 2-2, 4-2, 6-2 and 7-2![/b]

Check out the changelog below and again:

[b]Thank you so much![/b] 🙇

[h2]Lunistice ver. 1.02 Changelog[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [b]"Smooth Turning"[/b] option to the Gameplay Menu. Turning this off gives much more direct and sensitive control over Hana (they should feel close to the original Eversleep demos from last year).
[*][b]Added hotkey "L" to lock/unlock mouse cursor to/from the game window.[/b] This should hopefully help with the usage of certain accessibility software.
[*]Added failsafe for potential softlock spots. If the game recognizes players infinitely falling without hitting the ground they will now be snapped a few units upwards. This should (hopefully) prevent most softlock situations.
[*]Added toggle for Hana's All S-Ranks reward. The reward can now be toggled on/off per save slot if it has been unlocked on any save slot before.
[*]Added option to [b]expand vertical camera movement[/b]
[*][i]Begrudgingly added High-Res option[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Camera movement should now feel better when using Keyboard + Mouse
[*]Rebalanced parts of Stage 7-2
[*]Rebalanced parts of Stage 2-2
[*]Rebalanced parts of Stage 4-2
[*]Rebalanced parts of Stage 6-2
[*]Changed position of grinding indicator
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed softlock when entering a bubble while dying
[*]Fixed being able to smash water drop crystals in Stage 5-2 by running into them
[*]Fixed Toree's S-Rank achievements not triggering
[*]Fixed Toree randomly dying when loading a new level
[*]Fixed players getting stuck on the beginning of grind rails in specific cases
[*]Fixed collectible counter showing "CRANES" even for guest characters
[*]Fixed grind rail bar vanishing on big UI scale
[*]Fixed wrong behaviour for mushroom switches in 7-2
[*]Fixed Interface showing up in the sky in some stages
[*]Fixed some weirdness with DualSense controller mappings (hopefully)
[*]Fixed Karakasa slimes getting stuck in mid-air
[*][i]Fixed Stage 5-2 music[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: New Demo + Release Date Shift
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

As you might've seen already on my Social Media/Discord/Whatever, [b]we had to move the release date for Lunistice a little bit, due to... unforeseen circumstances![/b] As it turns out, beginning of September suddenly got really [i]REALLY [/i]packed with other releases and I wasn't 100% happy with the quality the full game was at!
So, to hopefully find a better day to release the game on and to give me a bit more time to polish, we're moving the release date [i]just a little bit![/i] I'll announce the final release date only when the game is 100% ready to go!

[b]To make up for the delay, I decided to prepare a completely new demo version for all of you! This new demo should now be representative of the final quality of the game and includes all improvements and additions I made to the full release version![/b] Check it out if you like and tell me what you think! You can also find a short version of the changelog below!

[b]Thanks so much for your time and for checking out Lunistice![/b] It's almost ready to go and I can't wait to show off my little "30-day project" to all of you! 💖

~Dennis

[h2]Changelog[/h2]

[h3]General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]New short intro cutscene
[*]Swapped old Stage 3 - 1 "Food 01" with the new "Park 01" stage in the demo, since the ordering of levels in the final game has changed a little bit
[*]The final soundtrack by the amazing knasibas is now in and all temp tracks have been removed!
[*]Removed Speedrun Mode, due to massive time constraints and technical difficulties
[*]Instead of Speedrun Mode, in the new profile select window you can now change your character at any time! Every character has their own progression and will have to unlock levels normally first. Keep in mind that in the final version, you will have to meet certain criteria to unlock the ability to change characters
[*]Removed "1994 mode", as supporting this feature for different platforms kind of became a huge problem due to my "30-day" spaghetti code base. The game will now run in low-res mode by default. Sorry!
[*]Added localizations for: English, Japanese, German, French, Italian & Spanish
[*]Hana finally got some clothes to wear!
[*]All new menus and stuff!
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the physics for Hana a lot, giving you better control over her movements. Give it a try! Especially when you had problems with her sliding off cliffs in the past
[*]New camera system
[*]Added a proper tutorial level
[*]Implemented a much better ranking system, now rewarding clean and thorough playthroughs instead of time spent in a level
[*]Added optional player drop shadow to help out with gauging where you can land during jumps
[*]All of the level designs have been expanded, tweaked and/or outright redone, giving all levels a bit more meat, some more interesting gameplay and a completely new look!
[*]The total number of collectibles in a stage is now shown during gameplay, due to levels not being limited to 100 collectibles per level anymore
[*]Player attack is now much more visible. You can now also collect collectibles using your attack!
[/list]

[b]...and much, much more. A lot has changed during this year![/b]

notes.title: Ginormous Demo Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

It's time for [i][b]Update Time[/b][/i]! Today the demo got a (comparatively) [b]massive update[/b]! Before I go over the features though, some words about the development of the game!

[h2]"What's up with the jumpy game, fox man?"[/h2]
It takes a little bit longer! As you might know, Eversleep was meant as a challenge to myself to create a commercially viable game in 30 days! And while I kinda-sorta made that goal (plus around 14 days, oh well) I kinda grew attached to the darn thing and wanted it to be really cool! As such, I'll be taking some additional time (mostly to avoid holiday season as well tbh) to not only boost the content a little bit, but also to give the game the treatment it deserves (like a full-on custom soundtrack by the amazing [url=https://twitter.com/KnasibasMusic][b]Knasibas[/b][/url]!)
So to make up to everyone and to give you a good idea on the current state of the game, I decided to update the free demo version to include[b] all the bells and whistles[/b] from the final release version!

[h2]A new stage to play![/h2]
The new demo now has an [b]additional stage for you[/b] to try out! I'd highly recommend not playing on an empty stomach though! 🍡🍡🍡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992870/e6ecdc88413e35c121224950310263a435615e18.jpg[/img]

[h2]Speedrun Mode + A Special Guest[/h2]
[b]Speedrun Mode[/b] has been activated for the demo version to give you an idea on how it'll work in the final version! This part is actually still a bit WIP, so only [b]Any%[/b] runs have been made available for now! You get those glods, yeah! And make sure to share your [b]best times[/b] on [url=https://twitter.com/AGrumpyFox][b]Twitter[/b][/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/YfXtjAR/][b]Discord[/b][/url] if you like! ❤
But wait, there's more! In Speedrun Mode you can play as one of the 4 upcoming guest characters! Play as Toree - the cute little birb from [b]Toree3D / Toree 2[/b] from indie developer [url=https://twitter.com/SIACTRO][b]SIACTRO[/b][/url]! They're super fast, can't attack and die in one hit - just like in the game they originated from! And if you like what you play, make sure to check out [b]Toree3D[/b] and [b]Toree 2[/b] as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554840/Toree_3D
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722620/Toree_2

[h2]A new soundtrack[/h2]
The great [url=https://twitter.com/KnasibasMusic][b]Knasibas[/b][/url] has blessed Eversleep with his sick tunes! Step by step, I'll be able to remove the current library music by his original compositions! For now there's [b]3 tracks made by him[/b] in the new demo version! 

[h2]An actual tutorial![/h2]
What do you mean "a simple overlay for the first 10 seconds of gameplay is not enough of a tutorial"?  [b]Fine, have it your way then![/b]

[h2]A ton of additional fixes and additions[/h2]
There's also a ton more stuff that we fixed and added, especially in terms of level design and structure! Like this amazing change to the level design in Stage 1 Act 1! [b]Applause, please![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40992870/9f083a03bdc38d34c8fcb3d2aea9b37d23bacc94.png[/img]

I really hope you enjoy the new and improved demo! I can't wait to see what you think and I'm super excited to show you the final game when it's done 💖

Thank you so much for playing!
